packageRules.description: ImageSharp 4.0 added a build-time licence check that fails `dotnet publish -c Release` without a sixlabors.lic key file. Only the Docker build catches it — `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass. Taking 4.x means registering for a complimentary OSS key and getting it into both CI and the image build, renewed yearly. See the note in AudiobookManager.Services.csproj.
